# Vendored file viewers

- PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 6.4.299: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js — Apache-2.0.
- Viewer.js 1.15.2: https://github.com/fengyuanchen/viewerjs — MIT.

These assets are copied from exact npm versions and served by this site. PDF.js uses the compatibility (`legacy`) builds of the core, worker and viewer with their matching resources. No third-party CDN is used at runtime. PDF.js core, worker, viewer and resources must be upgraded together. License files and resource-specific notices are retained in each directory.
